summary: Clarifies the approved startup/config-resolution intent boundary for Argo harness Neo4j connectivity setup: canonical Neo4j names must materialize runtime neo4jUri, QWEN_KEY must materialize runtime embeddingCredential, and unresolved runtime fields must fail closed before database, provider, or index side effects.
notes: Selected viewpoint: Requirements Realization Viewpoint. Stakeholder concern: runtime owners, ICT architects, security owners, and acceptors need approved external configuration names to be the only source for internal runtime fields before Neo4j connectivity, provider, or index side effects.

View binding: `grag-native-embedding-release-requirements` remains a Requirements Realization Viewpoint instance because it traces production runtime, credential constraint, embedding qualification, canonical Neo4j names, live provider evidence, and canonical authority to release requirements before index delivery.

Coverage matrix: `grag-production-runtime` functional point `functionalPoint.TS-01` -> `ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-TS-01`; `functionalPoint.TS-01-harness-env-loading` -> existing `ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-TS-01`, now covering exact `.argo/.env` loading plus start-time `neo4jUri` and `embeddingCredential` validation.

Coverage matrix: `grag-credential-boundary` functional point `functionalPoint.TS-07` -> `ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-TS-07`; `functionalPoint.TS-07-provider-secret-isolation` -> `ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-TS-07-Provider-Secret-Isolation`; `functionalPoint.TS-07-canonical-neo4j-env-names` -> existing `ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-TS-07` and `ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-TS-07-Provider-Secret-Isolation`.

Human approval: the human partner approved the existing-test boundary extensions for both observed blockers, `embeddingCredential is required for start` and `neo4jUri is required for start`; no new ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase identity was added because extension of TS-01, TS-07, and TS-07 Provider Secret Isolation remains adequate.
Acceptance boundary: `ARGO_NEO4J_DATABASE_URL` is the only approved source for in-process `neo4jUri`; legacy `ARGO_NEO4J_URI` never satisfies or overrides required configuration.

Acceptance boundary: `QWEN_KEY` is the only approved source for in-process `embeddingCredential`; separately supplied runtime-field keys, literals, defaults, command-line values, graph/Cypher values, or alternate files are forbidden.

Downstream ImplementationDesign should extend existing physical entrypoints `tests/explicit/entries/runProductionGraphRagRuntime.js`, `tests/explicit/entries/runExternalCredentialBoundary.js`, and `tests/explicit/entries/runLiveEmbeddingProviderSecretIsolation.js` where feasible, preserving existing secret non-disclosure rules and without reading real `.argo/.env` secret values.

Intent evidence: `argo.previewSystemArchitectureMutation` and `argo.applySystemArchitectureMutation` passed for two element updates and one Requirements Realization View update; counts remained 47 elements, 59 relationships, and 27 views. The MCP post-write Neo4j sync still reported `neo4jUri is required for start`; that setup failure is now an explicit downstream acceptance boundary rather than an unresolved intent-modeling blocker.
Secret handling: Intent Design did not read, create, output, migrate, copy, or expose any `.argo/.env` secret value.
